title: pro kummer derived unit
statement: Let n>0 be invertible on Z, R=ULift(Z/n), A a commutative ring killed by n, i:D→Z any scheme morphism and φ:R→A. If two Cartier Ext classes have GeoCartierScalarCompatibility [sk-lem-geo-cartier], then the normalized full pro-etale Kummer class G_m,pro→forget(A_Z(1))[1] is a degree-one scalar unit [def-sfb-cartier-reduction-data, def-sp-derived-scalar-ext-unit].

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: The pro-etale residue root map is an isomorphism: it is the inverse roots comparison, the image of the residue etale root isomorphism, and the coefficient-forgetting comparison isomorphism. Apply the residue Kummer unit theorem to the full pro-etale Kummer sequence through this kernel isomorphism. Extract the Tate-line derived unit from coefficient compatibility and compose the units. The normalized pro root-map scalar identity identifies the resulting Ext class with the given A-Kummer unit.

theorem pro_kummer_derived_unit
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hA : (n : A) = 0) (hR : (n : ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)) = 0)
    {D Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ Z) (hZ : IsUnit (n : Γ(Z, ⊤)))
    (φ : ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n) →+* A)
    (cR : GeoCartierClass (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)) n hR i)
    (cA : GeoCartierClass A n hA i)
    (hcompat : GeoCartierScalarCompatibility φ n hR hA i cR cA) :
    CartierScalarUnit (cartierForget A Z) (Scheme.proEtaleUnitsSheaf Z)
      (geoCartierLine A n hA Z) 1 (cartierProKummerUnit A n hA Z hn hZ)
